responsibility: Implements expansion of the built-in `core::panic!` and `std::panic!` front-end macro by rewriting each invocation to the edition-appropriate internal panic macro (`panic_2015!` or `panic_2021!`) in the referenced standard library crate. It also provides the shared edition-selection logic used by other built-in macros, walking expansion context to ignore internal wrappers like `assert!` when deciding which panic semantics apply.
